_comment: Film-grain parameters, baked from fotufilm packs by tools/sync_fotufilm_grain_params.py. Each entry carries the record curves the crystal population is read off and the grain constants that place it; `source` says where it came from -- fotufilm:<pack> for a measured sheet, derived:<sibling> for a stock that borrows a relative's coating, with `derivation` saying how. Do not hand-edit: re-run the tool.

fujifilm_velvia_100.name: Fujifilm Velvia 100
fujifilm_velvia_100.derivation: Fuji bulletin: diffuse RMS 8 at 48 µm, D = 1.0 above D-min (Velvia 50 keeps its own 9)

kodak_2383.name: Kodak Vision 2383
kodak_2383.derivation: print film, no camera-film sheet: borrows the Vision3 coating with a print-film strength

kodak_2393.name: Kodak Vision Premier 2393
kodak_2393.derivation: print film, finer than 2383: borrows the Vision3 coating with a print-film strength

kodak_portra_160.name: Kodak Portra 160
kodak_portra_160.derivation: Kodak publishes Print Grain Index, not RMS, for current Portra; kept 0.75x portra_400

kodak_portra_800.name: Kodak Portra 800
kodak_portra_800.derivation: Kodak publishes Print Grain Index, not RMS, for current Portra; kept 1.45x portra_400

kodak_vision3_200t.name: Kodak Vision3 200T
kodak_vision3_200t.derivation: no RMS in the Vision3 brochure (granularity curves only); kept 0.85x vision3_500t

kodak_vision3_50d.name: Kodak Vision3 50D
kodak_vision3_50d.derivation: no RMS in the Vision3 brochure (granularity curves only); kept 0.65x vision3_250d
